name: Computer Science Atlas
desc: A detailed, interactive course through university computer science: from programming and data structures to algorithms, theory of computation, computer systems, networks, databases, security, artificial intelligence and graphics.
desc_zh: 深入、可交互的大学计算机科学课程：从程序设计与数据结构，到算法、计算理论、计算机系统、网络、数据库、安全、人工智能与图形学。
lede: A detailed, interactive course through university computer science — from programming and data structures to algorithms, computability and complexity, computer systems, networks, databases, security and cryptography, artificial intelligence, graphics and software engineering. This is a skeleton: the courses and chapters are mapped out, and the lessons are still to be written.
lede_zh: 深入、可交互的大学计算机科学课程——从程序设计与数据结构，到算法、可计算性与复杂性、计算机系统、网络、数据库、安全与密码学、人工智能、图形学与软件工程。目前这是一个框架：课程与章节已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
foot: a free, detailed and interactive tour of the undergraduate computer science curriculum, written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks.
foot_zh: 一套免费、详尽、可交互的大学本科计算机科学课程导览，可配合课堂和教材阅读。
about_lede: Computer Science Atlas is a free, detailed tour of the computer science taught in a university degree — written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks, or on its own.
about_lede_zh: 计算机科学图谱是一套免费、详尽的大学计算机科学导览——可以配合课堂和教材阅读，也可以单独自学。
timeline_desc: From Babbage and Turing to the internet and modern cryptography: the ideas behind every course in the atlas.
timeline_desc_zh: 从巴贝奇和图灵到互联网和现代密码学：图谱中每门课程背后的思想。
timeline_lede: The ideas behind the courses, from mechanical calculators and Turing’s machines to compilers, operating systems, the internet and public-key cryptography. Coloured dots show the area; links lead to the course where the idea is taught.
timeline_lede_zh: 各门课程背后的思想：从机械计算器和图灵机，到编译器、操作系统、互联网和公钥密码学。彩色圆点表示所属领域；链接指向讲授该内容的课程。
card_desc: University computer science: programming and languages, data structures and algorithms, computability and complexity, computer systems, networks and distributed systems, databases and artificial intelligence, security and cryptography, graphics and software engineering. The curriculum is mapped out; the lessons are still to be written.
card_desc_zh: 大学计算机科学：程序设计与语言、数据结构与算法、可计算性与复杂性、计算机系统、网络与分布式系统、数据库与人工智能、安全与密码学、图形学与软件工程。课程体系已经规划好，课文尚待编写。

areas.label: Programming & languages
areas.blurb: Writing programs, and the languages and compilers that run them.
areas.blurb_zh: 编写程序，以及运行程序的语言和编译器。

areas.label: Algorithms & theory
areas.blurb: Data structures, algorithms, computability, complexity and quantum computation.
areas.blurb_zh: 数据结构、算法、可计算性、计算复杂性与量子计算。

areas.label: Computer systems
areas.blurb: How programs run on hardware: machines, operating systems and parallelism.
areas.blurb_zh: 程序如何在硬件上运行：机器、操作系统与并行计算。

areas.label: Networks & distributed systems
areas.blurb: Communication between computers, and systems spread across many machines.
areas.blurb_zh: 计算机之间的通信，以及分布在多台机器上的系统。

areas.label: Security & cryptography
areas.blurb: Protecting systems and data: threats, defences and the mathematics of secrecy.
areas.blurb_zh: 保护系统与数据：威胁、防御以及保密的数学。

areas.label: Data & intelligence
areas.blurb_zh: 数据库、信息检索与人工智能。

areas.label: Software & interaction
areas.blurb: Building software that works for people: engineering, graphics and interfaces.
areas.blurb_zh: 构建为人所用的软件：软件工程、图形学与人机交互。

lab_groups.discrete: Logic, sets, graphs and number theory
